CheckTitle: Security Groups with Microsoft RDP port (3389) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Microsoft RDP port.
Risk: An internet-accessible RDP port (3389) is constantly targeted by brute-force attacks, leading directly to full server compromise and ransomware deployment.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
